scope: Eight v18 high-risk chapters H21, H27, H42, H45, H53, H54, H73, H76; exact prior 217-row v18 source preserved
sourceAddressing: Scripture references in v18 are not consistently edition-tagged. Do not import traditional Esther references as CPDV by matching numbers.
editPolicy: Overlay keyed by H chapter and exact original reference; never overwrite v18 or canonical 151 event IDs.

chapters.title: Crossing the Sea
chapters.chronologyBoundary: H20 Passover precedes H21; H22 Sinai follows; canticle of Moses is a distinct poetic witness

units.editorialRationale: Exodus begins after Passover H20; preserve Pharaoh's dismissal and departure, not a duplicate Passover ritual.
units.principalRationale: Exodus begins after Passover H20; preserve Pharaoh's dismissal and departure, not a duplicate Passover ritual.

units.editorialRationale: Keep nonshortened route, Joseph's bones and pillar of cloud/fire; divine guidance connects H21 to its sea crossing.
units.principalRationale: Keep nonshortened route, Joseph's bones and pillar of cloud/fire; divine guidance connects H21 to its sea crossing.

units.editorialRationale: Restore Pharaoh's pursuit (14:5–10), fear/command, crossing, rescue and Moses/Miriam thanksgiving. Exodus 15 is a later distinct song, never disguised as part of the sea-crossing prose.
units.principalRationale: Restore Pharaoh's pursuit (14:5–10), fear/command, crossing, rescue and Moses/Miriam thanksgiving. Exodus 15 is a later distinct song, never disguised as part of the sea-crossing prose.

units.editorialRationale: Manna and quails are a distinct desert trial; retain hunger, divine promise and food's appearance rather than compress beyond recognition.
units.principalRationale: Manna and quails are a distinct desert trial; retain hunger, divine promise and food's appearance rather than compress beyond recognition.

units.editorialRationale: Keep thirst, command to strike the rock and giving water; Moses' omitted appeal remains in companion passage.
units.principalRationale: Keep thirst, command to strike the rock and giving water; Moses' omitted appeal remains in companion passage.

chapters.title: The Deliverers of Israel
chapters.h26Boundary: The recurring judges cycle belongs in H26, not duplicated in H27.

units.editorialRationale: Deborah and Barak's commission, Sisera's army, battle and Jael's decisive action remain; do not isolate the tent killing from the commission and pursuit.
units.principalRationale: Deborah and Barak's commission, Sisera's army, battle and Jael's decisive action remain; do not isolate the tent killing from the commission and pursuit.

units.editorialRationale: Gideon's reluctant call, divine promise and sign preserved; this is not the same event as his later victory.
units.principalRationale: Gideon's reluctant call, divine promise and sign preserved; this is not the same event as his later victory.

units.editorialRationale: Keep reduction to three hundred and trumpets/lamps, the victory's extraordinary means rather than simple military triumph.
units.principalRationale: Keep reduction to three hundred and trumpets/lamps, the victory's extraordinary means rather than simple military triumph.

units.editorialRationale: Protect birth announcement and Nazirite dedication before Samson's eventual moral collapse.
units.principalRationale: Protect birth announcement and Nazirite dedication before Samson's eventual moral collapse.

units.editorialRationale: Restore Delilah's betrayal, loss of strength and imprisonment before final prayer and death; this last act includes his death and the Philistine dead, without sanitizing the narration.
units.principalRationale: Restore Delilah's betrayal, loss of strength and imprisonment before final prayer and death; this last act includes his death and the Philistine dead, without sanitizing the narration.

units.editorialRationale: Narrative of refusal and outcome; verify skipped dialogue.
units.principalRationale: King's training, Daniel's refusal, tested outcome, and divine gift; names of companions remain explicit.

units.editorialRationale: Actual CPDV/Challoner Daniel 3:1–100 checked; v18 3:24–90 lacks decree, confrontation and rescue. Main short narrative retains refusal, protective angel, representative hymn and king's response, with explicit omission markers; complete canonical prayer/song independently accessible.
units.principalRationale: Complete moral sequence: coerced worship, refusal, fire, protection, praise, sight of fourth figure and deliverance; full Azariah prayer and Benedicite are independent companion.

units.editorialRationale: Restore decree and concluding proclamation.
units.principalRationale: Daniel's faithful prayer, jealous trap, lion's den, angelic preservation and king's proclamation; no interpolated narrator.

units.editorialRationale: Independent vision with its own prophetic setting.
units.principalRationale: An independent prophetic vision; principal sequence keeps Chebar setting, creatures, wheels, firmament and throne; complete vision remains available.

units.editorialRationale: Independent family narrative, not Daniel's timeline. All cuts require source-context check.
units.principalRationale: Retain Tobit's captivity and trial, Sarah's affliction, prayers heard, Raphael's concealed guidance, marriage with prayer, cure and the revelation of Raphael. Distinct family tale, not a Daniel episode.

units.editorialRationale: Restore siege, mission, climax and deliverance. Genre is not historical itinerary.
units.principalRationale: Retain siege and threatened surrender, Judith's identity and mission, prayer, Holofernes and his intoxication, Judith's act and the resulting Assyrian flight. Not treated as Daniel-era chronology.

units.editorialRationale: Actual CPDV witness read: Haman's decree in CPDV 5; risk/intercession in 7; Greek prayers in 7–8; Greek entrance expansion 9:1–16 distinct from the repeated entrance in 9:17–19; royal audience and banquets 9–11; reversal 12; Purim 14. The v18 Esther 4:1–17 edition remains UNDETERMINED; do not silently infer CPDV coordinates. All cuts visible; full Catholic additions separately navigable. Read-aloud transition check: CPDV 10:4–5 cannot be skipped without obscuring that Haman is the interlocutor; 14:1–2,16–22 preserve the violent reversal and institution of Purim, without sanitizing the passage.
units.principalRationale: Explicit CPDV order: upbringing, Haman's genocidal edict, Esther's risky choice, Greek Esther prayer, audience, accusation, counter-decree, defensive violence, and Purim. Greek expanded audience stays a companion, not a second consecutive entrance.

units.editorialRationale: Retain whole Matthew witness, including Abraham–David, Solomon, Babylon exile and Joseph described as Mary's husband; no inferred maternal lineage.
units.principalRationale: Retain whole Matthew witness, including Abraham–David, Solomon, Babylon exile and Joseph described as Mary's husband; no inferred maternal lineage.

units.editorialRationale: Retain the whole different Lucan witness reaching Adam, with Nathan rather than Matthew's Solomon; do not label it Mary's biological genealogy.
units.principalRationale: Retain the whole different Lucan witness reaching Adam, with Nathan rather than Matthew's Solomon; do not label it Mary's biological genealogy.

chapters.title: The Teaching of the Kingdom
chapters.genreBoundary: Explicit teaching anthology; not one consecutive Gospel discourse

units.editorialRationale: Retain the full beatitude series and its spoken setting; individual blessings are not disposable repetitions.
units.principalRationale: Retain the full beatitude series and its spoken setting; individual blessings are not disposable repetitions.

units.editorialRationale: Keep complete Our Father and Christ's forgiveness explanation; no verse excision.
units.principalRationale: Keep complete Our Father and Christ's forgiveness explanation; no verse excision.

units.editorialRationale: Wise and foolish builders form a deliberate contrast; retain Christ's final authority line.
units.principalRationale: Wise and foolish builders form a deliberate contrast; retain Christ's final authority line.

units.editorialRationale: Read the sower parable then Christ's own interpretation, with explicit omission markers for 13:10–17 on why he speaks in parables.
units.principalRationale: Read the sower parable then Christ's own interpretation, with explicit omission markers for 13:10–17 on why he speaks in parables.

units.editorialRationale: Short exorcism retained in full as a distinct sign.
units.principalRationale: Short exorcism retained in full as a distinct sign.

units.editorialRationale: Keep forgiveness, opposition and physical healing; do not present a shortened miracle without the authority to forgive sins.
units.principalRationale: Keep forgiveness, opposition and physical healing; do not present a shortened miracle without the authority to forgive sins.

units.editorialRationale: Storm, word of command, disciples' fear and Christological question form a complete short unit.
units.principalRationale: Storm, word of command, disciples' fear and Christological question form a complete short unit.

units.editorialRationale: Five loaves and two fish, sign, bread and crowds kept together; H56 Bread of Life may link this same source event but must not fork it into a second canonical event.
units.principalRationale: Five loaves and two fish, sign, bread and crowds kept together; H56 Bread of Life may link this same source event but must not fork it into a second canonical event.

units.editorialRationale: The physical cure cannot terminate before the formerly blind man's testimony and confession of faith; the intervening interrogation stays available in full.
units.principalRationale: The physical cure cannot terminate before the formerly blind man's testimony and confession of faith; the intervening interrogation stays available in full.

units.editorialRationale: Lydia's conversion at Philippi remains a five-verse unit.
units.principalRationale: Lydia's conversion at Philippi remains a five-verse unit.

units.editorialRationale: Restore Paul's liberation of enslaved divining girl and her owners' commercial motive; preserve prison prayer, earthquake, jailer's baptism and Roman citizen protest.
units.principalRationale: Restore Paul's liberation of enslaved divining girl and her owners' commercial motive; preserve prison prayer, earthquake, jailer's baptism and Roman citizen protest.

units.editorialRationale: Areopagus sermon requires Creator, repentance and Resurrection followed by mixed responses; do not truncate just at philosophical preface.
units.principalRationale: Areopagus sermon requires Creator, repentance and Resurrection followed by mixed responses; do not truncate just at philosophical preface.

units.editorialRationale: Keep Priscilla/Aquila, local response and divine reassurance at Corinth.
units.principalRationale: Keep Priscilla/Aquila, local response and divine reassurance at Corinth.

units.editorialRationale: Miletus farewell keeps commissioned overseers, apostolic vigilance, threat of false teachers and communal prayer, not a generic travel notice.
units.principalRationale: Miletus farewell keeps commissioned overseers, apostolic vigilance, threat of false teachers and communal prayer, not a generic travel notice.

units.editorialRationale: Danger on journey to Rome, ignored warning, storm, angelic assurance, crew's safety and shipwreck retained; itinerary detail remains navigable in full.
units.principalRationale: Danger on journey to Rome, ignored warning, storm, angelic assurance, crew's safety and shipwreck retained; itinerary detail remains navigable in full.

units.editorialRationale: Open ending of Acts: preaching to the Jews in Rome, mixed reception, mission to Gentiles and two years of unhindered proclamation.
units.principalRationale: Open ending of Acts: preaching to the Jews in Rome, mixed reception, mission to Gentiles and two years of unhindered proclamation.

units.editorialRationale: Four horsemen as first vision; martyrs 6:9–11 are linked companion.
units.principalRationale: Retain all four distinct seals/horses; abbreviating individual horse images compromises the unit's parallel structure. Martyrs under the altar and white-robed multitude remain linked Catholic Scripture companion readings.

units.editorialRationale: Trumpet introduction otherwise stops before the first trumpet sounds.
units.principalRationale: Preserve seventh-seal silence, incense and prayers, the actual first trumpet, the fourth trumpet and three remaining woes. Clearly disclose omitted second/third trumpets (8:8–11) rather than imply consecutive verses.

units.editorialRationale: Both the installed CPDV and DR Challoner witnesses contain verse 12:18 ('he stood upon the sand of the sea'), the transition into 13:1. Include in this edition-specific chapter boundary.
units.principalRationale: Sun-clothed woman, dragon, male child, Michael, defeat of accuser through Lamb's blood, persecution of faithful offspring and seashore transition. The intervening woman's flight and protection (12:12–16) is omitted from the principal but preserved in full chapter. The woman has rich Catholic ecclesial and Marian readings; do not reduce the imagery to a single unsupported literal equation.

units.editorialRationale: Retain both beasts; do not stop after first beast.
units.principalRationale: Keep sea beast, deceptive recovery, worship, persecution of saints, perseverance, land beast, enforced image worship and mark. CPDV and Challoner differ in the second beast's grammatical pronouns; retain each edition's original wording rather than conflating them.

units.editorialRationale: Identify Babylon and preserve final judgment. Linked Revelation 14:1–5 as hope counterpoint.
units.principalRationale: Identify Babylon and her persecution, kings allied with beast but overcome by Lamb, announced fall, summons to God's people, final judgment and martyrs' blood. Do not claim the abbreviated vision alone explains the whole symbolism or that Revelation follows a simple chronological sequence.

auditMethod: Direct extraction of checked-in CPDV and Douay–Rheims verse arrays; confirm own source-edition references. No reproduced Bible words in research overlay.
statusNote: Eight high-risk chapters now have provisional source-based principal readings preserving the original v18 segments. Not publication-approved; pericope frequency, full literary review, legal rights and contextual linkage remain open.

revelationEditorialBoundary.h78: Revelation 21–22 reserved; not absorbed into H76
revelationEditorialBoundary.interpretation: Symbolic/apocalyptic visions, not an asserted literal event-by-event chronological timeline
